book.title: Nzryr-krbz Pol Kx Ayrnrngr Mz Timoti

content: Ncblo Kx Takitrde Nzwzngr Mz Nzaclve-krde Dzbe Lrmakxtr
Da angidr lc tqpibo. Mrlx kc tqpq zlwz mz drtwrde nzwzngr mz nzaclve-krde dzbe lrmakxtr, suti drtwrde nzwzngr kxmrlz-esz'ngr.

Kxacvle lc nangi ncblo kxtubq, kx trnzpibqtiu leplz. Nayrlzti-txpwzle olvz naesz', mz mzli kxesz' bzkq aoti drtwrde nzvz-krbzle mz olvz kzbleng. Na-aclve-lzbq, nayrplapx, x na-amrlue leplz. X naokatrle lr narnrlc mz nzadwatr-krde nidr mz ma nyzde. X nzalvztr-krde natq Gct natubq.
Bzkq rmnq zlwz. Bzkq drtwrde ngya, a' nalolvzo-lzbq. X bzkq otablr, a' nangi ncblo ngr nrwx. X bzkq mrlz zlwz bade trau.
Namailz-angidrlr lr manyzdeng, x naokatrle doa nedeng mz nzvz-nqblq-krdr natqdeng mz nzamatqngr.
Murde ncblo kx trmailz-angidrleu lr manyzdeng, trtakitrdeu nide nzaclve-krde dzbe lrmakxtr neng Gct.

Kxaclve lc nangi kz ncblo kx nzrlxngiti-krde brpe. A' bzkq mcpxq ncblo kx nzrlxngiti-krde pobe, murde ma tqani txpwz nzglqpx-lzbq-krde, da kc tqwai Setzn. X mz nzglqpx-lzbq-krde lc, tqaxvctr-lzbq-kzpz mz nzayrplapxkr Gct Setzn.
X kxaclve lc nangi ncblo kx nzamatq kz leplz kcng trngiu lrmakxtr, murde ma tzpibqtilr nide x tqatrkati Setzn nzwz-krde mz Nrpakxmrlz.
Ncblo Kx Takitrde Nzwzngr Mz Nzaclve-krde Dalr Makxtr
Mz nqmq lcpwz, ncblo kx nzyrlq mz nzaclve-krde dalr makxtr nangi kz ncblo kx nzamrlue leplz. Bzkq kx natqde tresz'tiu. Bzkq rmnq zlwz. X bzkq mrlz zlwz bade nzrngiscngr trau kxkqlu.
A' nalolvz-angidrle nzrlxngitingr kc tqaelwapx-ngrm Gct bagu.
Timoti, obqtr kai mz leplz lcng na-aclvelr dalr makxtr. Nzmu kx trpnzngr da kx vz-rbrtrpz badr, sc tzngi ate kxnzaclveng dalr makxtr.

Mz nqmq lcpwz, olvz kx aclvele dalr makxtr o olvz r ncblo kxaclvele dalr makxtr nangi olvz kx nzamatqng leplz amrlx. Bzkq nznginidr olvz kx narpikiting. A' na-aclve-lzbqng x nangini nidr olvz kx nzabrkitr drtwr mz da amrlx.
Ncblo kxaclvele dalr makxtr nalzde olvz naesz'txu x bzkq aoti drtwrde nzvz-krbzle mz olvz kzbleng. A' namailz-angidrle doa nedeng x lrmanyzdeng amrlx murde navz-nqblq-kzlr nzrlxngitingr angidr.
X kxacvlele dalr makxtr kc tqwz angidr sa narmctile kx leplz nzamatqlr nide. Mz nzmu-krde lcde, nelzde nabr mz nzyapwxtipx-krbzle nzlxngiti-krde Mevalu Jiszs.

Mwx mzli trnaboiu ninge kc tqvzpebo bam. A' mzli ka nayr-kaipo da lcng bam, murde ma trvz-anipwc'u. Da lcng tzalvztr-ngrdr nimu da kx takitrde leplz neng Gct kc tqlu, mz nzprtr-krdr mz dzbe leplz kcng tzrlxngiting amrlx. Murde nqmq kr kxnzrlxngiting na-aelwapx-zvz-ngrde kx Nrpa ngr Kraes da angidrtx, mz nzvz-nqblq-zpwx-krdrle. X namc-zpwxlr kx leplz nzyapwxtipxlr nzalvztrngr angidr, murde Nrpa ngr Gct na-angidati-zpwxle me pnz drtwrde.

X Gct aelwapxpe-ngrde nzalvztrngr angidr ngr Mevalu Kxnzmcpx. X drtwrgu esz'ti mz nzplzpx-lxblr-krgule. Delc tqrpi-zvz-ngrgu kx, “Lxngitiku Jiszs Kxnzmcpx kc tqaelwapx-lzbqpe mz nrkrdrtq leplz, x tqaelwapxngr Mqngrkxtr nzngini-angidr-krde Mrlx Gct, mz nzatulz-mou-krdele mz nzbz-krde. X lxngitiku nzmckr enjrl neng Gct nide mz nibr nztulz-krmle, nzvzmilzkr Gct nide me matq-esz'ngr Heven, nzyapwxtipx-ngrbz Nrpa ngrde mz lr nrlc, x nzlxngitikr leplz nide mz nrlc tulvzo.”

footnotes.text: Mz nzrtekqtrngr ‘kxnzaclvelr dzbe lr makxtr,’ leplz nzyro natq lcde seleng: kxaclve, pasto, bisop, presbitz, x lrtzlvz. A' nzalelr nzwzngr kcpwz. Mrkc mz trmctu nyzgu, nzkqle-ngrbzng nidr pris (o mama) x pasto. X dikon ngr COM nzprtr-kzng mz kxnzaclveng. A' nakrlz-kzku kx pris mz makxtr nyz Kristin mzli ka nzblepxbzng mz pris r lr Jiu mz Nzryrngrkxtr. Mc ‘kxnzaclvelr dzbe lrmakxtr’ mrkc mz Nzalvztr-ngrng Kxmyapxbz.

Mz nzrtekqtrngr ‘ncblo kxnzaclveng dalr makxtr,’ leplz nzyro natq lcde ‘dikon.’ A' dikon lc, blepxbz mz dikon ngr COM. Murde krlc mz Nzryrngrkxtr nzwz-krde nzaclve-krde dalr makxtr. Mz makxtr nyzgu nidr ‘srs kipa,’ ‘srs kcmiti,’ ‘kxaclvele trau,’ kxnzokatrng mz nzmailz-krdr dzbedeng mz makxtr, x leplz kx nzaleng nzwzngr kxnzmulr lcng. Mc ‘kxnzaclveng dalr makxtr’ mz Nzalvztr-ngrng Kxmyapxbz.
